name: Hyundai i30 N Performance (PD, 2018)
chassisNote: FWD Performance Package hatch; hatch archetype + sport tyres / e-LSD (clsd).

gearset.src: Hyundai EU/DE technical data (Nov 2018) and later i30 N sheets: 3.083/1.931/1.696/1.276/1.027/0.854, reverse 3.588; final 4.333 (1/2/R) and 3.250 (3/4/5/6). Gears 3–6 scaled by 3.250/4.333 for a single fd (GR Yaris pattern).

enginePreset.name: Hyundai G4KH 2.0 T-GDI (i30 N Performance)
enginePreset.note: Theta II G4KH Performance Package: 275 PS @ 6000, 353 Nm from 1450–4700 with overboost to 378 Nm (brochure). Store the sustained 353 Nm plateau as tqLimit; overboost is brief and not modelled separately. Twin-scroll turbo; peak boost ~1.2 bar on DE technical sheet (unsure confirmation of continuous rating).

sources.body: https://www.hyundai.news/newsroom/dam/de/Pressemappen/i30_N/hyundai_i30_n_nov2018_technische_daten.pdf — Cd 0.33, Stirnfläche 2.23 m², wb 2650, 1795×1447, tracks 1556/1564, DIN kerb lightest 1429 kg (Performance).
sources.performance: Hyundai e-brochure / DE technical data: 0–100 6.1 s, top 250 km/h (Performance Package).
sources.gearset: Hyundai DE technical data Nov 2018 and EU i30 N technical specifications PDF — dual final 4.333 / 3.250.
sources.fit: DE technical data: 235/35 R19, front discs 345 mm (Performance), multilink rear, N Corner Carving e-LSD.

note: Pinned 2018 PD hatch Performance Package 6MT (275 PS), not the later 280 PS facelift or DCT. body.kg uses Hyundai's lightest DIN kerb 1429 kg; if that DIN figure includes the 75 kg driver, subtract 75 (listed unsure). Published frontal area 2.23 m² used (not w×h×0.81). fWt 0.62 layout estimate for FWD hot hatch. Overboost 378 Nm is not a sustained plateau — tqLimit stays 353. Factory aero inside Cd.
